title: Understanding differences in legal interpretation
text:
His Majesty’s Revenue and Customs commissioned the National Centre for Social Research to carry out qualitative research to understand differences in legal interpretation.

 The research was carried out between October and November 2025 with large businesses, medium-sized businesses and agents of wealthy customers who had encountered a legal interpretation issue in the last 12 to 18 months. The research consisted of 27 45 minute depth interviews conducted by telephone or online. The findings from this research are illustrative and not representative of this population.

 The views in this report are the author’s own and do not necessarily reflect those of HMRC.
